title: OS: Banker's algorithm, worked step by step

rows: what each process may still ask for
an order in which every process can finish
grant it only if the state stays safe

say.en: Banker's algorithm decides whether the operating system can safely give resources to a process, without ever reaching deadlock.
say.te: Banker's algorithm అంటే, deadlock రాకుండా, ఒక process కు resources ఇవ్వడం safe అవునా కాదా అని operating system decide చేసే method.

say.en: It is named after a bank, which lends money only if it can still pay every customer back in some order.
say.te: దీనికి bank పేరు ఎందుకంటే, ఒక bank తన customers అందరికీ ఏదో ఒక order లో pay చేయగలిగితేనే loan ఇస్తుంది.

say.en: We will work one exam problem through four stages.
say.te: మనం ఒక exam problem ను four stages లో solve చేస్తాం.

say.en: First the need matrix, then the available vector, then the safety check, and last a new request.
say.te: First need matrix, తర్వాత available vector, తర్వాత safety check, last గా ఒక new request.

say.en: Here is the problem. There are five processes, P0 to P4, and three resource types, A, B and C.
say.te: ఇది problem. ఇక్కడ P0 నుంచి P4 వరకు five processes, A, B, C అనే three resource types ఉన్నాయి.

say.en: The system has 10 instances of A, 5 of B and 7 of C in total.
say.te: System లో total గా A వి 10, B వి 5, C వి 7 instances ఉన్నాయి.

say.en: The allocation column is what each process holds right now. P0 holds zero A, one B and zero C.
say.te: Allocation column అంటే ప్రతి process ఇప్పుడు hold చేస్తున్న resources. P0 దగ్గర zero A, one B, zero C ఉన్నాయి.

say.en: The max column is the most each process may ever ask for. P0 may need up to seven A, five B and three C.
say.te: Max column అంటే ప్రతి process ever అడగగలిగే maximum. P0 కు up to seven A, five B, three C అవసరం కావచ్చు.

say.en: Every process declares its max in advance. That is what lets the system plan ahead.
say.te: ప్రతి process తన max ను advance గా declare చేస్తుంది. అందుకే system advance గా plan చేయగలదు.

say.en: The first question is how much more each process can still ask for. That is called its need.
say.te: First question: ప్రతి process ఇంకా ఎంత more అడగగలదు? దాన్నే need అంటారు.

say.en: Need is max minus allocation: the most it may want, minus what it already holds.
say.te: Need అంటే max minus allocation: అది want చేసే maximum లో నుంచి already hold చేస్తున్నది minus చేస్తాం.

say.en: For P0, seven five three minus zero one zero gives seven four three.
say.te: P0 కు, seven five three minus zero one zero చేస్తే seven four three వస్తుంది.

say.en: For P1, three two two minus two zero zero gives one two two.
say.te: P1 కు, three two two minus two zero zero చేస్తే one two two వస్తుంది.

say.en: The same subtraction for P2, P3 and P4 gives six zero zero, zero one one, and four three one.
say.te: అదే subtraction P2, P3, P4 కు చేస్తే six zero zero, zero one one, four three one వస్తాయి.

say.en: A quick check: no need can be negative, because no process holds more than its max.
say.te: ఒక quick check: ఏ need కూడా negative కాకూడదు, ఎందుకంటే ఏ process కూడా తన max కంటే more hold చేయదు.

say.en: Next, how much of each resource is free right now. This is the available vector.
say.te: Next, ఇప్పుడు ప్రతి resource ఎంత free గా ఉంది? దీన్నే available vector అంటారు.

say.en: Available is the total minus everything that is already allocated.
say.te: Available అంటే total minus already allocate అయినవి అన్నీ.

say.en: Add down the allocation column. For A, zero plus two plus three plus two plus zero is seven. B adds to two, and C to five.
say.te: Allocation column ను add చేద్దాం. A కు zero plus two plus three plus two plus zero, seven. B add చేస్తే two, C add చేస్తే five.

say.en: Ten five seven minus seven two five leaves three three two free.
say.te: Ten five seven minus seven two five చేస్తే three three two free గా ఉంటాయి.

say.en: Now the main question: is there an order in which every process can finish? If there is, the state is safe.
say.te: ఇప్పుడు main question: ప్రతి process finish అయ్యే order ఏదైనా ఉందా? ఉంటే, ఆ state safe.

say.en: We start with work equal to available, three three two, and every process marked not finished.
say.te: Work = available, అంటే three three two తో start చేస్తాం, ప్రతి process not finished గా ఉంటుంది.

say.en: The rule: if a process's need fits in work, it can run to the end and then give back everything it holds.
say.te: Rule: ఒక process need, work లో fit అయితే, అది end వరకు run అయి, తను hold చేసినవన్నీ return చేస్తుంది.

say.en: So work grows by that process's allocation, and we mark it finished.
say.te: కాబట్టి work కు ఆ process allocation add అవుతుంది, దాన్ని finished గా mark చేస్తాం.

say.en: We scan from P0 to P4, and go back to the top until no process can move.
say.te: P0 నుంచి P4 వరకు scan చేస్తాం, ఏ process కూడా move చేయలేనంత వరకు మళ్ళీ top నుంచి start చేస్తాం.

say.en: P0 needs seven four three, but work has only three A. Seven does not fit in three, so P0 waits.
say.te: P0 కు seven four three need, కానీ work లో three A మాత్రమే. Seven, three లో fit కాదు, కాబట్టి P0 wait చేస్తుంది.

say.en: P1 needs one two two. One is at most three, two is at most three, and two is at most two, so it fits.
say.te: P1 కు one two two need. One, three కంటే less, two, three కంటే less, two, two కి equal, కాబట్టి fit అవుతుంది.

say.en: P1 finishes and returns two zero zero. Work becomes three three two plus two zero zero, which is five three two.
say.te: P1 finish అయి two zero zero return చేస్తుంది. Work, three three two plus two zero zero, అంటే five three two.

say.en: P2 needs six A, but work has five. It waits.
say.te: P2 కు six A need, కానీ work లో five మాత్రమే. అది wait చేస్తుంది.

say.en: P3 needs zero one one, which fits in five three two.
say.te: P3 కు zero one one need, అది five three two లో fit అవుతుంది.

say.en: P3 returns two one one, so work becomes seven four three.
say.te: P3 two one one return చేస్తుంది, కాబట్టి work seven four three అవుతుంది.

say.en: P4 needs four three one, which fits in seven four three.
say.te: P4 కు four three one need, అది seven four three లో fit అవుతుంది.

say.en: P4 returns zero zero two, so work becomes seven four five.
say.te: P4 zero zero two return చేస్తుంది, కాబట్టి work seven four five అవుతుంది.

say.en: Back to the top. P0 needs seven four three, and now that fits in seven four five.
say.te: మళ్ళీ top కు. P0 కు seven four three need, ఇప్పుడు అది seven four five లో fit అవుతుంది.

say.en: P0 returns zero one zero, so work becomes seven five five.
say.te: P0 zero one zero return చేస్తుంది, కాబట్టి work seven five five అవుతుంది.

do.text: Work = (7, 5, 5)    order: P1, P3, P4, P0

say.en: P2 needs six zero zero, which fits in seven five five. It returns three zero two, and work becomes ten five seven.
say.te: P2 కు six zero zero need, అది seven five five లో fit అవుతుంది. అది three zero two return చేస్తుంది, work ten five seven అవుతుంది.

say.en: Every process finished, so the state is safe. The safe sequence is P1, P3, P4, P0, P2.
say.te: ప్రతి process finish అయ్యింది, కాబట్టి ఈ state safe. Safe sequence: P1, P3, P4, P0, P2.

do.text: Safe sequence: P1 → P3 → P4 → P0 → P2

say.en: Check: the final work, ten five seven, equals the total. Every resource came back, as it must.
say.te: Check: final work ten five seven, total కి equal. ప్రతి resource back వచ్చింది, అలాగే రావాలి.

say.en: Other orders can be safe too, such as P1, P3, P4, P2, P0. Any order where each need fits is accepted, so show your scan in the exam.
say.te: వేరే orders కూడా safe కావచ్చు, example గా P1, P3, P4, P2, P0. ప్రతి need fit అయ్యే ఏ order అయినా accept చేస్తారు, కాబట్టి exam లో మీ scan ను show చేయండి.

say.en: Now P1 asks for one more A and two more C: the request one zero two. Should the system grant it?
say.te: ఇప్పుడు P1, one more A, two more C అడుగుతుంది: request one zero two. System దాన్ని grant చేయాలా?

say.en: First check: a request may not exceed the process's need. One zero two is within P1's need, one two two.
say.te: First check: request, process need ను exceed చేయకూడదు. One zero two, P1 need అయిన one two two within లోనే ఉంది.

say.en: Second check: it may not exceed what is available, three three two. It does not, so the resources exist.
say.te: Second check: అది available అయిన three three two ను exceed చేయకూడదు. చేయదు, కాబట్టి resources ఉన్నాయి.

say.en: Now we pretend to grant it. Available drops to two three zero.
say.te: ఇప్పుడు grant చేసినట్టు pretend చేస్తాం. Available, two three zero కు drop అవుతుంది.

say.en: P1's allocation rises to three zero two, and its need falls to zero two zero.
say.te: P1 allocation three zero two కు rise అవుతుంది, దాని need zero two zero కు fall అవుతుంది.

say.en: The request is granted only if this new state is still safe, so we run the safety check again.
say.te: ఈ new state ఇంకా safe అయితేనే request grant అవుతుంది, కాబట్టి safety check మళ్ళీ run చేస్తాం.

say.en: With work two three zero, P0 does not fit, but P1 now needs only zero two zero, and fits. Work becomes five three two.
say.te: Work two three zero తో P0 fit కాదు, కానీ P1 కు ఇప్పుడు zero two zero మాత్రమే need, fit అవుతుంది. Work five three two అవుతుంది.

say.en: P2 still does not fit. P3 fits, making seven four three, and then P4 fits, making seven four five.
say.te: P2 ఇంకా fit కాదు. P3 fit అయి seven four three, తర్వాత P4 fit అయి seven four five అవుతుంది.

say.en: On the second pass P0 fits, giving seven five five, and P2 fits, giving ten five seven.
say.te: Second pass లో P0 fit అయి seven five five, P2 fit అయి ten five seven వస్తుంది.

say.en: Every process can still finish, so the new state is safe and the request is granted. The sequence is again P1, P3, P4, P0, P2.
say.te: ప్రతి process ఇంకా finish అవ్వగలదు, కాబట్టి new state safe, request grant అవుతుంది. Sequence మళ్ళీ P1, P3, P4, P0, P2.

say.en: If some process could never fit, the request would be refused and P1 would wait, even though the resources are free.
say.te: ఏదైనా process ఎప్పటికీ fit కాకపోతే, request refuse అవుతుంది, resources free గా ఉన్నా P1 wait చేయాలి.

say.en: To recap the four stages. One: need is max minus allocation.
say.te: Four stages ను recap చేద్దాం. One: need అంటే max minus allocation.

say.en: Two: available is the total minus everything allocated.
say.te: Two: available అంటే total minus allocate అయినవి అన్నీ.

say.en: Three: the safety check grows work one finished process at a time. The state is safe if every process can finish.
say.te: Three: safety check లో ఒక్కో process finish అయినప్పుడు work grow అవుతుంది. ప్రతి process finish అవ్వగలిగితే state safe.

say.en: Four: a request is granted only if it fits the need, fits what is available, and leaves the state safe.
say.te: Four: request need లో fit అయి, available లో fit అయి, state ను safe గా ఉంచితేనే grant అవుతుంది.
